main_html:
Free for families

Get matched with a senior living community

Answer a few questions about care needs, memory, budget and timing. We introduce your family to licensed communities that fit, and you decide who to call and tour.

Start your request

Primary action

Submit a routing request

A few questions about your parent's care needs, memory, budget and timing. It takes about three minutes.

%%SENIOR_INTAKE%%

Before you submit

Have your parent's main diagnoses, the help they need each day and a rough monthly budget to hand. If your parent is in hospital, the planned discharge date helps most.

Who this is for

  • Adult children and spouses choosing assisted living or memory care for someone in the Memphis area, Germantown, Collierville, Bartlett, Cordova, DeSoto County or West Memphis.
  • Families facing a hospital discharge who need licensed options within days.
  • Families who would rather have a short list of communities that have room and fit the budget than call every community in the directory.

What happens next

  • We read what you told us and look for licensed communities with room for that level of care.
  • A community that wants to talk with you accepts the introduction, and only then do they receive your contact details.
  • You tour, ask questions and decide. You are never obliged to choose anyone we introduce.

How we are paid: our guide is free to families. Senior living communities pay us a referral fee or a flat fee when they accept a family we introduce, and some buy sponsored placements.

Prefer to look first? Every licensed community is listed on the Memphis page and each city page, with phone numbers.
